column2: [intro]
In this world so dull and gray,
Where everyone just wants to shine all day,
I'm here to turn it all around,
With my quirky ideas, let’s astound!
If you own it, it’s good taste,
Let your wild side make haste,
Forget the norms and the taboos,
Come and have fun with us, it’s true!
They say it’s bad taste,
When I dance like a madman, in every space,
But I don’t care, I’m free at all ends,
I’m the king, yeah baby, it’s my trend!

Let your wild side make haste,
Forget the norms and the taboos,
Come and have fun with us, it’s true!
